sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们有一个大风扇，不过我是说。

sentences.en: Well, the fan, we have no air conditioning.
sentences.zh: 嗯，风扇是有的，我们没有空调。

sentences.en: It gets to 130.
sentences.zh: 温度能达到130华氏度。

sentences.en: It was 136?
Up on top.
sentences.zh: 顶部最高处。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: How do you know that?
sentences.zh: 你怎么知道的？

sentences.en: It was here before?
sentences.zh: 以前就在这儿吗？

sentences.en: Because the...
sentences.zh: 因为……

sentences.en: With the thermometer.
sentences.zh: 用温度计测的。

sentences.en: Yeah, we show the thermometer so people don't think I'm lying.
sentences.zh: 对，我们展示温度计是为了让大家觉得我没有撒谎。

sentences.en: Uh, the inmates are all wearing striped black and white jumpsuits, and they all have pink towels.
sentences.zh: 呃，犯人们都穿着黑白相间的囚服，他们还都拿着粉红色的毛巾。

sentences.en: You know, I see a lot of pink around.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我看到周围有很多粉红色。

sentences.en: Of course, we're in the ladies' section, but I believe the men's section is pretty much the same, right?
sentences.zh: 当然，我们在女囚区，但我相信男囚区也差不多，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The men not only have pink towels, but they also have pink underwear that they wear.
sentences.zh: 男囚不仅有粉色毛巾，他们穿的内衣也是粉红色的。

sentences.en: Wait, why do they have pink underwear?
sentences.zh: 等等，为什么他们要穿粉红色内衣？

sentences.en: Well, the official explanation from Sheriff Joe Arpaio is that...
sentences.zh: 嗯，乔·阿尔帕约警长的官方解释是……

sentences.en: I think 1995 went to pink underwear because they were smuggling the white underwear out of jail, two, three pairs at a time.
sentences.zh: 我想1995年开始换成粉色内衣，是因为他们把白内衣偷运出监狱，一次偷两三套。

sentences.en: Decided to go to pink because nobody wears pink.
sentences.zh: 所以决定改成粉红色，因为没人会穿粉红色。

sentences.en: Now everybody's wearing pink.
sentences.zh: 现在每个人都穿着粉红色。

sentences.en: So that was the reason.
sentences.zh: 这就是原因。

sentences.en: The other reason is they don't like pink.
sentences.zh: 另一个原因是他们不喜欢粉红色。

sentences.en: You mean the men?
sentences.zh: 你是说男人们？

sentences.en: The men.
sentences.zh: 男人们。

sentences.en: The story, as pretty much everybody believes it is, is that it's basically an attempt at control.
sentences.zh: 正如大多数人所相信的那样，这基本上是一种试图控制的手段。

sentences.en: So it's an attempt at subjugation.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种征服的手段。

sentences.en: Here is your striped jumpsuit, and here is your pink underwear, and that's where you're going to have to wear while you're in jail.
sentences.zh: 这是你的囚服，这是你的粉红色内衣，你在监狱里就得穿这些。

sentences.en: I took away all the Tvs.
sentences.zh: 我拿走了所有的电视。

sentences.en: They have a cafeteria and a break room that has television sets that are usually set to the Weather Channel and the Food Network.
sentences.zh: 他们有一个自助餐厅和一个休息室，里面有电视机，通常都调到天气频道和美食频道。

sentences.en: The reason I show them the Weather Channel, because when it's snowing in Canada, and it's 130 degrees in a tent, maybe they'll take a trip to go to Canada and don't come back here.
sentences.zh: 我让他们看天气频道的理由是，当加拿大在下雪，而帐篷里有130度高温时，也许他们会想去加拿大旅游，然后就别再回来了。

sentences.en: It is very hot here in Arizona in the summer, in Phoenix in the summer.
sentences.zh: 亚利桑那州的夏天这里非常热，凤凰城的夏天尤其如此。

sentences.en: Like extremely hot.
sentences.zh: 简直热极了。

sentences.en: Extremely hot.
sentences.zh: 热得要命。

sentences.en: And it doesn't let down at night.
sentences.zh: 而且到了晚上也没有丝毫减退。

sentences.en: So the Weather Channel sort of adds a little element of cruelty to the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 所以天气频道给这一切平添了一点残酷的意味。

sentences.en: And then the Food Network was because some years ago, Sheriff Arpaio decided that the inmates should have what he calls a vegetarian diet.
sentences.zh: 至于美食频道，是因为几年前阿尔帕约警长决定让犯人们吃他所谓的素食。

sentences.en: In fact, what's her name?
sentences.zh: 事实上，她叫什么名字来着？

sentences.en: Pamela Anderson Baywatt.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉·安德森·拜瓦特。

sentences.en: She was nice enough to come here and help me change the menu to vegetarian.
sentences.zh: 她非常友善地来到这里，帮我把菜单改成了素食。

sentences.en: Pamela Anderson came here to promote the vegetarian meals in the jail.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉·安德森来这里是为了推广监狱里的素食。

sentences.en: Probably not known that they were probably some of the worst food anybody could ever eat.
sentences.zh: 可能大家都不知道，这可以说是任何人能吃到的最难吃的食物之一了。

sentences.en: How do you like the food?
sentences.zh: 你们觉得这饭菜怎么样？

sentences.en: I can't stand it.
sentences.zh: 我简直受够了。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 对不起。

sentences.en: It's disgusting.
sentences.zh: 太恶心了。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's really bad.
sentences.zh: 对，真的很糟。

sentences.en: I stopped eating it completely.
sentences.zh: 我彻底不吃了。

sentences.en: In fact, Arpaio has said that his dogs eat better than the people he holds in his jail.
sentences.zh: 事实上，阿尔帕约曾说过，他的狗吃得都比他关在监狱里的人好。

sentences.en: The potatoes and beans and stuff ain't bad.
sentences.zh: 土豆和豆子之类的东西还不错。

sentences.en: I just don't like the slop all that well, but the potatoes and beans and stuff like that, they're really good.
sentences.zh: 我只是不太喜欢那种糊状食物，但土豆和豆子之类的东西，真的很好吃。

sentences.en: And honestly, with the butter, it's actually not too bad.
sentences.zh: 老实说，加了黄油的话，其实还挺不错的。

sentences.en: Some of them said they did like the food, and at that point he said, what are you talking about?
sentences.zh: 有些人说他们确实喜欢这些食物，而在那种情况下他说，你在说什么呢？

sentences.en: You make me look bad when you say the food is good.
sentences.zh: 你说饭菜好吃是在让我出丑。

sentences.en: You ruin my reputation.
sentences.zh: 你在毁我的名声。

sentences.en: Why are you saying that?
sentences.zh: 你为什么这么说？

sentences.en: I don't care.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎。

sentences.en: Don't say it's good.
sentences.zh: 别说它好吃。

sentences.en: No, I don't.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有。

sentences.en: Tell the truth.
sentences.zh: 说实话。

sentences.en: And he brags about it.
sentences.zh: 而他对此还津津乐道。

sentences.en: He was never one to feel bad about any of that.
sentences.zh: 他从来都不是那种会为此感到内疚的人。

sentences.en: He thinks that that's what makes him a tough guy.
sentences.zh: 他认为这正是他硬汉风范的体现。

sentences.en: And you said you showed the food channel.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说你给他们放美食频道。

sentences.en: Why do you show the food channel here?
sentences.zh: 你为什么在这里放美食频道？

sentences.en: So they learn how to cook when they get out.
sentences.zh: 这样他们出去后就能学会怎么做饭。

sentences.en: But don't you think it's kind of mean if they are served slop and food that is of clearly very poor quality to be watching?
sentences.zh: 但你不觉得如果给他们提供的是难吃的糊状食物和明显很劣质的饭菜，却让他们看这个，有点太刻薄了吗？

sentences.en: Well, when they get out, they learn how not to cook vegetarian.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当他们出去的时候，他们就学会了怎么不做素食。

sentences.en: So when they get out, they know how to cook the food that they like.
sentences.zh: 所以等他们出去后，他们就知道怎么做自己喜欢的饭菜了。

sentences.en: They don't like the vegetarian.
sentences.zh: 他们不喜欢素食。

sentences.en: So I give them the food channel.
sentences.zh: 所以我给他们看美食频道。

sentences.en: I think that's nice to teach them how to cook.
sentences.zh: 我觉得教他们做饭挺好的。

sentences.en: And from then, he went to the chain gangs, which he started.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，他转向了由他发起的强迫劳役链枷队。

sentences.en: And let me just understand this because I have an image of a chain gang.
sentences.zh: 让我理清一下，因为我对链枷队有一个刻板印象。

sentences.en: And in my mind, they're like completely obsolete.
sentences.zh: 在我的印象中，这已经是彻底过时的东西了。

sentences.en: It's just like the image you have in your mind.
sentences.zh: 这就像是你脑海中的那种画面。

sentences.en: It's people in striped black and white jumpsuits.
sentences.zh: 人们穿着黑白相间的囚服。

sentences.en: And they have chains around their ankles.
sentences.zh: 他们的脚踝上戴着铁链。

sentences.en: And they're kind of linked together by these chains.
sentences.zh: 他们被这些铁链串联在一起。

sentences.en: And they're doing work a lot of time.
sentences.zh: 而且他们经常要干活。

sentences.en: It's cleaning the side of highways.
sentences.zh: 通常是清理高速公路边。

sentences.en: You know, picking trash from the side of highways.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在高速公路旁捡垃圾。

sentences.en: Other types of what he calls community projects.
sentences.zh: 其他他所谓的社区服务项目。

sentences.en: So they're on the streets cleaning up trash, put them on the main streets, not hide them.
sentences.zh: 所以他们在大街上清理垃圾，把他们安排在大街上，而不是藏起来。

sentences.en: And when the cars drive by with the mother and father, with Johnny in the back seat, I hope they point at the chain gang.
sentences.zh: 当汽车开过去，车里坐着爸爸妈妈，后座还带着小明时，我希望他们会指着链枷队。

sentences.en: And they say, if you do anything wrong, you're going to be on that chain gang.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会说，如果你做了坏事，你就会去加入那个链枷队。

sentences.en: And the women and the men do understand that.
sentences.zh: 女犯和男犯都很清楚这一点。

sentences.en: So they are really helping to deter crime by virtue of that program.
sentences.zh: 所以通过这个项目，他们确实在很大程度上起到了震慑犯罪的作用。

sentences.en: So I really have a lot of thanks for the chain gang.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的很感谢链枷队。

sentences.en: And he started with men.
sentences.zh: 他最初是从男犯开始的。

sentences.en: And then he expanded to include female inmates as well in these chain gangs.
sentences.zh: 然后他扩大了范围，也将女犯纳入了这些链枷队中。

sentences.en: I'm an equal opportunity incarcerator.
sentences.zh: 我是个机会均等的监禁者。

sentences.en: We started with the men.
sentences.zh: 我们从男犯开始。

sentences.en: And then why not let the women go on a chain gang?
sentences.zh: 那为什么不让女犯也去加入链枷队呢？

sentences.en: That would be discrimination, not allowing them to do it.
sentences.zh: 不允许她们参加那才是歧视。

sentences.en: When you two were touring the tent jails, you asked him a question that I suspect a lot of people have about how he squares these practices,
sentences.zh: 当你们两个参观帐篷监狱时，你问了他一个问题，我猜这也是很多人对他的做法的疑问，

sentences.en: the pink underwear and the outdoor all season exposure to the elements with the agony of some of the people who end up crossing the border into the United States.
sentences.zh: 比如粉红色内衣和全天候的户外风吹日晒，与那些历经千难万险跨越边境来到美国的流亡者的痛苦相比，他是如何把这些调和起来的？

sentences.en: And you use the example of, you know, a mother from Honduras,
sentences.zh: 你举了这样一个例子，你知道的，一个来自洪都拉斯的母亲，

sentences.en: which is a really violent country where people flee because they think that their children might die and come to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常暴力的国家，人们逃离那里是因为他们担心自己的孩子会死掉，于是来到美国，

sentences.en: seeking a better life for their children.
sentences.zh: 为孩子们寻求更好的生活。

sentences.en: And you asked him, what do you say to families like that?
sentences.zh: 你问他，你对这样的家庭有什么话说？

sentences.en: Or how do you make peace with arresting those people and putting them in this kind of environment?
sentences.zh: 或者你是如何心安理得地逮捕这些人并将他们置于这种环境中的？

sentences.en: He looked at me and he said, what do you think, a guy like me that's been around so many years, I don't have a heart?
sentences.zh: 他看着我说道，你觉得呢，像我这样经历过这么多年的老家伙，难道没有心吗？

sentences.en: Come on, I have a heart.
sentences.zh: 拜托，我是有心的。

sentences.en: You think I go home and I say, oh, just locked up 20 more illegals?
sentences.zh: 你以为我回家后会说，哦，今天又关了20个非法移民？

sentences.en: I don't think of it that way.
sentences.zh: 我才不这么想呢。

sentences.en: I'm just enforcing a law until that law is changed.
sentences.zh: 我只是在法律修改之前负责执行法律。

sentences.en: Sometimes I get in trouble because whatever I do, I do good.
sentences.zh: 有时我惹上麻烦是因为无论我做什么，我都做得很好。

sentences.en: My whole life has been like that.
sentences.zh: 我的一生都是这样的。

sentences.en: And it struck me because that's what a lot of people think, that Joe Arpaio just doesn't have a heart.
sentences.zh: 这让我触动很深，因为很多人都认为乔·阿尔帕约就是铁石心肠。

sentences.en: This is a place that some lawyers have said they are a human rights violation, the way people are treated here.
sentences.zh: 一些律师曾表示，这里对待人们的方式简直是对人权的侵犯。

sentences.en: There was a moment that I can't stop thinking about that I think sums up so many of the moral complexities of all this.
sentences.zh: 有一个时刻让我挥之不去，我认为它概括了这一切中太多的道德复杂性。

sentences.en: You ask a female inmate about the conditions inside this tent city jail.
sentences.zh: 你向一名女囚询问了帐篷城市监狱内部的条件。

sentences.en: What do you think about tent city?
sentences.zh: 你觉得帐篷城市怎么样？

sentences.en: It's a place you don't even want to come back.
sentences.zh: 这是一个你连想都不想再来的地方。

sentences.en: I think that's the whole purpose behind it.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是它的全部目的所在。

sentences.en: You're not supposed to want to come back ever again.
sentences.zh: 你绝不应该再想回到这里来。

sentences.en: And that is actually the same point that Sheriff Arpaio makes about the conditions in this jail he has created.
sentences.zh: 这实际上也是阿尔帕约警长对他所创造的这座监狱的条件所持的观点。

sentences.en: Well, this is rehabilitation because they hate it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是改造，因为他们痛恨这里。

sentences.en: So they're not going to come back.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不会再回来了。

sentences.en: Okay?
sentences.zh: 好吗？

sentences.en: I'm rehabilitating them in a different way.
sentences.zh: 我正在用一种不同的方式改造他们。

sentences.en: And the point seems to be that it's a deterrent.
sentences.zh: 关键似乎在于这是一种震慑。

sentences.en: And I wonder if it actually accomplished that goal of deterring people from coming back to that jail.
sentences.zh: 我想知道它是否真的达到了阻止人们再次回到那座监狱的目标。

sentences.en: The short answer is no.
sentences.zh: 简短的回答是，并没有。

sentences.en: Rates of recidivism, meaning the number of people who left jail and then came back to jail, never really went down.
sentences.zh: 累犯率，也就是离开监狱后又再次入狱的人数，从来没有真正下降过。

sentences.en: But very quickly it became clear that it was a big publicity tool for him, that it allowed him to have all these reporters from all over the world come and talk to him.
sentences.zh: 但很快人们就清楚地发现，这对他的宣传来说是一个巨大的工具，它让来自世界各地的记者都能来找他采访。

sentences.en: So even though he created this jail to save money and to prevent recidivism, according to him, that was his goal.
sentences.zh: 所以尽管他创建这座监狱是为了省钱和防止累犯，据他所说，这就是他的目标。

sentences.en: Neither of them was accomplished.
sentences.zh: 但这两点都没有实现。

sentences.en: So, Fernanda, how do we get from the tent jail to this moment?
sentences.zh: 那么，费尔南达，我们是如何从帐篷监狱走到这一步的？

sentences.en: How does the sheriff finally land himself in big legal trouble rather than just day-to-day controversies over his practices?
sentences.zh: 警长最终是如何陷入严重的法律麻烦，而不仅仅是日常关于其行事方式的争议的？

sentences.en: So, Sheriff Arpaio was sued, there was a class action lawsuit over his policing practices.
sentences.zh: 所以，阿尔帕约警长被起诉了，针对他的执法方式有一项集体诉讼。

sentences.en: Basically, a group of Latinos claimed that he was discriminating against them in the way that he conducted his raids and traffic stops and other types of enforcement operations.
sentences.zh: 基本上，一群拉丁裔指控他在突袭、交通拦截和其他类型的执法行动中对他们存在歧视。

sentences.en: Eventually, he was found to have indeed used discriminatory practices, violated the constitutional rights of Latinos in Maricopa County.
sentences.zh: 最终，他被发现确实使用了歧视性做法，侵犯了马里科帕县拉丁裔的宪法权利。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So he was ordered by a federal district court judge to change the practices of his office.
sentences.zh: 因此，他被联邦地区法院法官命令更改其办公室的做法。

sentences.en: He was given some time to do that.
sentences.zh: 他获得了一定时间来完成这项工作。

sentences.en: There were hearings throughout the process.
sentences.zh: 整个过程中举行了多次听证会。

sentences.en: And at some point, the judge said that he had not made the changes that the court had ordered him to.
sentences.zh: 在某个时候，法官表示他没有做出法院命令他进行的更改。

sentences.en: That basically he did it.
sentences.zh: 基本上他确实做了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: He knew what he was doing was wrong, but he did it anyway.
sentences.zh: 他明知故犯，知道自己在做错事。

sentences.en: And even when the judge told him to stop, he kept doing it.
sentences.zh: 甚至当法官叫他停下时，他还是继续这样做。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Essentially, he kept what the judge said is that he kept acting as an immigration officer.
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，法官的意思是说他继续充当移民官员。

sentences.en: He kept enforcing immigration laws, to be more precise.
sentences.zh: 准确地说，他继续执行移民法。

sentences.en: And there is nothing in the state statute in Arizona that allows him to do that, which is what led to the guilty verdict in July, which then would have led to a sentencing,
sentences.zh: 亚利桑那州的州法规中没有任何条款允许他这样做，这就是导致七月份被判有罪的原因，随后本应导致量刑宣判，

sentences.en: which was scheduled for October 15th.
sentences.zh: 原定于10月15日宣判。

sentences.en: So that brings us to President Trump.
sentences.zh: 这就把我们带到了特朗普总统这里。

sentences.en: When you talked to Sheriff Arpaio back in May, the tent city jail system had just been shut down.
sentences.zh: 5月份你与阿尔帕约警长交谈时，帐篷城监狱系统刚刚被关闭。

sentences.en: He's in serious legal jeopardy.
sentences.zh: 他正处于严重的法律困境中。

sentences.en: But President Trump is a few months into his administration, and he started to crack down on illegal immigration in the United States.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普总统上任几个月后，便开始打击美国的非法移民。

sentences.en: What is the relationship between these two men?
sentences.zh: 这两个人之间是什么关系？

sentences.en: So Joe Arpaio was, if I'm not mistaken,
sentences.zh: 所以，乔·阿尔帕约，如果我没记错的话，

sentences.en: the first large sort of national figure or nationally recognized name to stand up and stand next to candidate Trump on the campaign trail and support his candidacy.
sentences.zh: 是第一位站出来支持特朗普候选资格并站在竞选之路上特朗普候选人身边的全国性大人物或全国知名人物。

sentences.en: So I'm the only one that got up there really and introduced him, and I said he'll be our next president.
sentences.zh: 所以我是唯一一个真正站出来介绍他的人，我说他将成为我们的下一任总统。

sentences.en: And I guess being a senior citizen, I guess I've been around so long, understanding human nature, that I was right.
sentences.zh: 我想作为一个老年人，我可能活了很久，了解人性，我是对的。

sentences.en: He introduced Donald Trump in all of the rallies or spoke at all of the rallies that Donald Trump had here in Arizona.
sentences.zh: 他介绍了唐纳德·特朗普参加的所有集会，或者在唐纳德·特朗普在这里亚利桑那州举行的所有集会上发言。

sentences.en: There were seven of them during the campaign.
sentences.zh: 竞选期间共有七场。

sentences.en: I remember very vividly being in Mesa, Arizona, at one of these rallies at an airport hangar.
sentences.zh: 我非常清晰地记得在亚利桑那州梅萨市机场机库举行的其中一场集会上。

sentences.en: He says things that a lot of people would like to say, but they don't have the guts politically to say it.
sentences.zh: 他说出了很多人想说但政治上没有勇气说出的话。

sentences.en: So, and that's sad, really sad.
sentences.zh: 所以，这很悲哀，真的很悲哀。

sentences.en: And one thing I'm really happy about, he opened the door on illegal immigration.
sentences.zh: 我真正高兴的一件事是，他打开了非法移民问题的大门。

sentences.en: Nobody else had the guts to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 没有其他人有勇气谈论它。

sentences.en: Think of that.
sentences.zh: 想想看。

sentences.en: Now they all have to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 现在他们都不得不谈论它了。

sentences.en: Sheriff Arpaio lent the whole argument about getting tough on illegal immigration that essentially lifted Donald Trump's candidacy,
sentences.zh: 阿尔帕约警长为严厉打击非法移民的整体论点做出了贡献，这实质上提升了唐纳德·特朗普的候选资格，

sentences.en: that the door pie lent the legitimacy to that argument.
sentences.zh: 阿尔帕约赋予了这一论点合法性。

sentences.en: He was key to giving credence to that and saying, I'm tough and this guy is going to be tough too.
sentences.zh: 他对于赋予其可信度至关重要，并表示，我很强硬，这家伙也会很强硬。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And the sheriff seems to really relate to Trump from what I can tell from your interview with him.
sentences.zh: 根据我对你对他的采访的了解，警长似乎真的与特朗普很有共鸣。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, they share a birthday, flag day, as Sheriff Arpaio always talks about.
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道，正如阿尔帕约警长经常说的那样，他们同一天生日，即国旗日。

sentences.en: And my guy, same day, Trump.
sentences.zh: 还有我的老兄，同一天，特朗普。

sentences.en: And he talks about also about the fact that his wife, Sheriff Arpaio's wife, Ava, she has cancer.
sentences.zh: 他还谈到他的妻子，阿尔帕约警长的妻子艾娃患有癌症的事实。

sentences.en: And he mentioned that to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他向唐纳德·特朗普提到了这一点。

sentences.en: I said to him, I said, you know what?
sentences.zh: 我对他说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: You've done a lot for my wife.
sentences.zh: 你为我妻子做了很多。

sentences.en: And I said, with the cancer, she just watches TV, follows you, keeps her mind.
sentences.zh: 我说，得了癌症，她只是看电视，关注你，保持清醒的头脑。

sentences.en: He said, what do you mean?
sentences.zh: 他说，你是什么意思？

sentences.en: And he said, she's got cancer.
sentences.zh: 他说，她得了癌症。

sentences.en: I said, yeah, give me that phone.
sentences.zh: 我说，是的，把电话给我。

sentences.en: So he calls her.
sentences.zh: 于是他给她打了电话。

sentences.en: And then subsequent to that, he's called her three, four more times.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，他又给她打了三四次电话。

sentences.en: And that really, I think, made Sheriff Arpaio sort of understand that beyond the political relationship they had,
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实让阿尔帕约警长意识到，除了他们拥有的政治关系之外，

sentences.en: that there was something human about Donald Trump, at least in that interaction that they had.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普身上还有人性的一面，至少在他们之间的那次互动中是这样。

sentences.en: Because he was taking a lot of heat about women and all this, you know, treats them like this, treats them like this.
sentences.zh: 因为他受到了很多关于女性以及诸如此类的指责，你知道，这样对待她们，那样对待她们。

sentences.en: Well, he didn't treat my wife like that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他可没有那样对待我妻子。

sentences.en: He was a gentleman, cared for her health, and I'll never forget that in my political or other careers.
sentences.zh: 他是个绅士，关心她的健康，在我的政治或其他生涯中，我永远不会忘记这一点。

sentences.en: And it was from the heart.
sentences.zh: 那是出自内心的。

sentences.en: If he was just playing that, I wouldn't have any respect for him.
sentences.zh: 如果他只是在演戏，我就不会尊重他了。

sentences.en: But he didn't have to call several times after that.
sentences.zh: 但他之后没必要打好几次电话。

sentences.en: And now you have a president who is in the White House implementing orders and doing things that are just like a lot of the things you did.
sentences.zh: 现在你有一位身处白宫的总统，他正在实施行政命令，做着很多和你做过的事情一样的事情。

sentences.en: But you got in trouble for some of it.
sentences.zh: 但你却因为其中一些事情惹上了麻烦。

sentences.en: It's kind of ironic in some ways.
sentences.zh: 从某些方面来看，这有点讽刺。

sentences.en: He will follow through on his promises.
sentences.zh: 他会兑现自己的承诺。

sentences.en: That's the type of guy he is.
sentences.zh: 他就是那种人。

sentences.en: And I'm not saying ego.
sentences.zh: 我不是说自负。

sentences.en: It's just he says he's going to do something.
sentences.zh: 只是他说过要做某事，

sentences.en: He'll do it.
sentences.zh: 他就会去做。

sentences.en: And he's starting to do, you know, taking a little heat on a few things.
sentences.zh: 而且他开始行动了，你知道，在几件事情上承受了一些压力。

sentences.en: But the illegal immigration, he's working on it.
sentences.zh: 但在非法移民问题上，他正在努力。

sentences.en: And I've done the same thing.
sentences.zh: 我也做了同样的事情。

sentences.en: He totally feels validated and pride in having come out so early and so visibly in support of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他完全感到自己的价值得到了肯定，并为如此早、如此引人注目地支持唐纳德·特朗普而感到自豪。

sentences.en: So, you know, the pardon is just sort of like the cherry on the cake, you know, the icing on the cake.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，特赦就像蛋糕上的樱桃，你知道，锦上添花。

sentences.en: It's just the sort of like the less bit of validation that he needed to show that not only did he support the right person,
sentences.zh: 这就像他需要的最后一点肯定，以证明他不仅支持了正确的人，

sentences.en: but also that everything that he believed in and tried to do is now being attempted or done on a national level.
sentences.zh: 而且他信仰并试图做的所有事情现在正在国家层面被尝试或执行。

sentences.en: And finally, Fernanda, in your interview with the sheriff, which was back in May, did you even think of asking him about the possibility of a presidential pardon?
sentences.zh: 最后，费尔南达，在你五月份对警长的采访中，你有没有想过问他关于总统特赦可能性的问题？

sentences.en: Did that even cross your mind?
sentences.zh: 这甚至掠过你的脑海吗？

sentences.en: I just, having seen all that he got away with over the years, I remember thinking to myself, well, he's not going to go to jail.
sentences.zh: 我只是，看到他这些年逃脱了所有罪责，我记得当时心里在想，嗯，他不会去坐牢的。

sentences.en: And the way that it made most sense for him not to go to jail was for President Trump to pardon him.
sentences.zh: 对他来说不上监狱最合理的解释就是特朗普总统特赦他。

sentences.en: And it would be the easiest and quickest way to get it over with.
sentences.zh: 这将是结束此事最简单、最快的方式。

sentences.en: And that's exactly what happened.
sentences.zh: 事实也的确如此。

sentences.en: Thank you, Fernanda.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，费尔南达。

sentences.en: Thank you so much, Michael.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: I think of really, a couple of things, maybe I would have done it a little different, you know.
sentences.zh: 我想真的，有几件事，也许我会做得稍微不同，你知道的。

sentences.en: Like what?
sentences.zh: 比如什么？

sentences.en: Maybe some personal matters or something like that.
sentences.zh: 也许是一些私事之类的事情。

sentences.en: But what would you have done differently than what you did when you were in office?
sentences.zh: 但是，你在任时做的事情，你会有什么不同的做法吗？

sentences.en: Is there anything that you regret that you did?
sentences.zh: 你做过的事有什么后悔的吗？

sentences.en: And then looking back, you think, hmm, that wasn't the smartest choice, Joe.
sentences.zh: 然后回想起来，你会想，嗯，那不是最明智的选择，乔。

sentences.en: Well, the answer to the regret, since you brought that up, too, you're bringing stuff up.
sentences.zh: 好吧，关于后悔的回答，既然你也提到了这个，你正在挑起话题。

sentences.en: I'm just responding.
sentences.zh: 我只是在回应。

sentences.en: But you've always answered my question.
sentences.zh: 但你总是回答我的问题。

sentences.en: You use the word regret.
sentences.zh: 你用了“后悔”这个词。

sentences.en: So regrets, I've had a few, but too few to mention.
sentences.zh: 所以遗憾，我经历过一些，但少得不值一提。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您尚未订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Hey, Adam, it's Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，亚当，我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: Hello, Michael.
sentences.zh: 你好，迈克尔。

sentences.en: You work seven days a week.
sentences.zh: 你每周工作七天。

sentences.en: Well, I had Saturday off.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我周六休息。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: And you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: Supreme Court reporter in the summer has no right to complain.
sentences.zh: 夏天当最高法院记者没有什么好抱怨的。

sentences.en: You're a school teacher.
sentences.zh: 你是一名学校老师。

sentences.en: I'm jealous.
sentences.zh: 我很嫉妒。

sentences.en: Adam Liptak, what was the constitutional violation that Sheriff Arpaio committed and that a judge held him in contempt for?
sentences.zh: 亚当·利普塔克，阿尔帕约警长犯下的、并被法官裁定蔑视法庭的宪法违宪行为是什么？

sentences.en: So the courts found that Sheriff Arpaio had violated the Constitution and violated its Equal Protection Clause by targeting Latinos, whether they were unlawful immigrants or not,
sentences.zh: 法院发现阿尔帕约警长针对拉丁裔（无论他们是否是非法移民），违反了宪法和平等保护条款，

sentences.en: and detaining them merely on the suspicion of being here unlawfully by dint of the color of their skin.
sentences.zh: 并且仅仅因为怀疑他们仅凭肤色就在这里非法而拘留他们。

sentences.en: So he was basically charged with not following the Constitution and being told that he hadn't been following it and doing it anyway.
sentences.zh: 所以他基本上被指控不遵守宪法，并且在被告知他不遵守宪法后依然我行我素。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So this case is different from some cases in which people get pardons.
sentences.zh: 所以这个案件与人们获得特赦的一些案件不同。

sentences.en: You know, someone commits a crime, a crime that's on the books, and later expresses remorse, and the president pardons that person, and that's fairly conventional.
sentences.zh: 你知道，某人犯了罪，即现行法律规定的罪行，后来表示悔意，然后总统特赦了那个人，这相当常规。

sentences.en: Here the crime is violating the efforts of another branch of government to have someone follow the Constitution and follow court orders.
sentences.zh: 这里所犯的罪是破坏政府另一部门为让人遵守宪法和法院命令所做出的努力。

sentences.en: And that's significant because if a court orders you to do something, even if you think that court is wrong, you don't have the option.
sentences.zh: 这很重要，因为如果法院命令你做某事，即使你认为法院是错的，你也没有别的选择。

sentences.en: You can't commit civil disobedience.
sentences.zh: 你不能进行公民不服从。

sentences.en: Your requirement is to appeal.
sentences.zh: 你的要求是上诉。

sentences.en: He did something different.
sentences.zh: 他做了不同的事。

sentences.en: So for President Trump to exercise what everyone agrees is his constitutional right to pardon anybody he wants to for any federal crime,
sentences.zh: 因此，特朗普总统行使每个人都同意的宪法权利，即可以为任何联邦罪行特赦任何人，

sentences.en: nonetheless raises significant questions about his respect for the separation of powers, the rule of law, and the Constitution itself.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，这仍然引发了人们对其是否尊重权力分立、法治以及宪法本身的重大质疑。

sentences.en: It sounds like what you're saying is that the president has used his constitutional power to pardon, to pardon someone for what a judge found to be a violation of the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 听起来你的意思是，总统利用其宪法特赦权，去特赦一个被法官裁定违宪的人。

sentences.en: Exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And I'm guessing that does not sit well with legal experts?
sentences.zh: 我猜这不会让法律专家们感到高兴？

sentences.en: A lot of legal experts say that of all the ways to use the pardon power, this one is the most troubling.
sentences.zh: 许多法律专家表示，在所有行使特赦权的方式中，这种方式最令人不安。

sentences.en: Some of them say this is the clearest case of an impeachable offense yet.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人表示，这是迄今为止最明显的可以弹劾的罪行案例。

sentences.en: But it's a funny thing, Michael, because you start by acknowledging that he has this right, but he uses this right in a way that seems to test the constitutional structure.
sentences.zh: 但这是一件有趣的事，迈克尔，因为你首先承认他有这种权利，但他使用这种权利的方式似乎在考验宪法结构。

sentences.en: So how are presidential pardons typically used?
sentences.zh: 那么总统特赦通常是如何使用的？

sentences.en: Is there such a thing as a typical use of a presidential pardon?
sentences.zh: 是否存在总统特赦的典型用法这种说法？

sentences.en: Yeah, well, typically, after due consideration in the office of the pardon attorney in the Justice Department,
sentences.zh: 是的，通常情况下，在司法部特赦律师办公室经过适当审议之后，

sentences.en: including usually a five-year waiting period after the person has served his or her time,
sentences.zh: 通常包括在服刑完毕后五年的等待期，

sentences.en: after they've expressed remorse, and on the understanding that accepting a pardon is an admission of guilt,
sentences.zh: 在他们表达悔意之后，并且在理解接受特赦就是认罪的前提下，

sentences.en: presidents generally later in their terms will sometimes pardon low-level drug offenders and sometimes pardon cronies and allies and associates.
sentences.zh: 总统通常在任期后期有时会特赦低毒品犯罪分子，有时会特赦亲信、盟友和同伙。

sentences.en: So this is sort of in the zone of what presidents do, but really on one edge of the zone.
sentences.zh: 所以这有点在总统惯常做法的范围内，但确实处于该范围的边缘。

sentences.en: And to understand what you just said, Sheriff Joe has not served any time, and he has not displayed any remorse.
sentences.zh: 为了理解你刚才所说的话，乔警长没有服刑，也没有表现出任何悔意。

sentences.en: Quite right.
sentences.zh: 一点没错。

sentences.en: He hasn't even been sentenced yet.
sentences.zh: 他甚至还没有被宣判。

sentences.en: So he was convicted.
sentences.zh: 所以他被定罪了。

sentences.en: The sentencing was to have happened in October.
sentences.zh: 量刑宣判本应在十月份进行。

sentences.en: Adam, can you remind us of some of the more infamous presidential pardons pre-Trump?
sentences.zh: 亚当，你能提醒我们一些特朗普之前更声名狼藉的总统特赦案例吗？

sentences.en: Well, of course,
sentences.zh: 当然，

sentences.en: the most famous one is President Gerald Ford pardoning President Richard Nixon after Nixon's resignation in the face of impending impeachment in connection with the Watergate scandal.
sentences.zh: 最著名的是杰拉尔德·福特总统在理查德·尼克松因水门事件丑闻面临弹劾而辞职后特赦了尼克松总统。

sentences.en: Well, President Clinton got in quite a lot of political hot water for pardoning Mark Rich, a fugitive financier.
sentences.zh: 嗯，克林顿总统因特赦在逃金融家马克·里奇而陷入相当大的政治麻烦中。

sentences.en: And the first President Bush pardoned the former Defense Secretary, Caspar Weinberger, for his role in the Iran-Contra affair.
sentences.zh: 第一位布什总统特赦了前国防部长卡斯帕·温伯格，因为他在伊朗门事件中扮演的角色。

sentences.en: So it's not unheard of for presidents to issue controversial pardons.
sentences.zh: 所以总统发布有争议的特赦并非闻所未闻。

sentences.en: The reason these more controversial pardons tend to happen not only at the end of a presidential term, but at the end of a presidential administration,
sentences.zh: 这些更具争议的特赦往往不仅发生在总统任期结束时，而且发生在总统行政当局结束时，

sentences.en: is sometimes there would be a real political cost to be paid for an unpopular pardon, as Gerald Ford found out when he failed to win election after pardoning Richard Nixon.
sentences.zh: 原因是有时对于不受欢迎的特赦需要付出真正的政治代价，正如杰拉尔德·福特在特赦理查德·尼克松后竞选失败所发现的那样。

sentences.en: So we learned on Sunday from our colleague Maggie Haberman that President Trump had tried to get the Department of Justice,
sentences.zh: 因此，我们在周日从我们的同事玛吉·哈伯曼那里获悉，特朗普总统曾试图让司法部，

sentences.en: his Department of Justice, to intervene in the Arpaio case and have it dismissed,
sentences.zh: 他自己的司法部，介入阿尔帕约案并将其撤销，

sentences.en: and that the president was rebuffed by his attorney general, Jeff Sessions.
sentences.zh: 而总统遭到了其司法部长杰夫·塞申斯的回绝。

sentences.en: Does that, Adam, change our understanding of this case or the ethics involved?
sentences.zh: 亚当，这是否改变了我们对本案或其中涉及的伦理问题的理解？

sentences.en: It kind of feels like the president was going to find one way or another to keep the sheriff out of jail.
sentences.zh: 这感觉就像总统无论如何都要想方设法让这位警长免于牢狱之灾。

sentences.en: Well, presidential interference with a pending prosecution is really unusual and really suggests a disregard for the rule of law.
sentences.zh: 嗯，总统对进行中的起诉进行干预非常罕见，这确实表明他对法治的漠视。

sentences.en: So if that's the background of what happened here, that may raise additional questions about the prudence and wisdom and respect

sentences.en: that President Trump does or does not have for the usual procedures, for the separation of powers and for the Constitution itself.
